subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Fuel Injection Takes Over
description: One-minute skill: Fuel Injection Takes Over.

hook.text: Electronic fuel injection replaced the carburetor by metering fuel with computer precision.

buildup.text: Sensors measure airflow, temperature, and throttle position dozens of times per second.

discovery.text: The computer calculates exact fuel needs and commands injectors to spray into the intake.

twist.text: Fuel injection improved power, efficiency, and cold starts so dramatically that carburetors vanished.

climax.text: The switch to injection cut emissions enough to meet strict clean-air laws of the 1980s.

punchline.text: A computer replaced a century of mechanical guesswork.

quiz.question: What was a key advantage of fuel injection over carburetors?
